tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa'i brgyud 'debs dang sgrub thabs tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa kun blo'i gsung bzhugs so// ༈ /rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi brgyud 'debs rol pa'i rta skad rab bskul zhes bya ba// ༈ /kun khyab chos sku snang ba mtha' yas dang*// bde chen longs spyod rab rdzogs rta mgrin dbang*// 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i sku mchog pad+ma 'byung*// gsol ba 'debs so bdud dang dam sri thul// thugs rje'i dbang phyug dbon ston skyer sgang pa// sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gnyan ston chos kyi rje// 'gro ba'i mgon po sangs rgyas ston pa'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdud dang dam sri thul// gtsang pa shangs ston rgyal mtshan 'bum pa'i zhabs// tshul khrims mgon po ri khrod ras chen dang*// sangs rgyas rdo rje thar pa dpal bzang la// gsol ba= /sangs rgyas rnam rgyal tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*// kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse rje btsun dbang rab zhabs// bsod nams mchog ldan zur chen rin po che// gsol ba= /kun gzigs lnga pa pad+ma 'phrin las zhabs// mor chen rdo rje 'chang dbang gnas gsar ba// kun dga' blo gros kun dga' mkhas grub dbang*// gsol ba= /pad+ma gar dbang sgyu 'phrul wā gin+d+ra/

ngag dbang legs sgrub/ /zab gsang gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin a nan+da/ kun dga' 'jam dbyangs/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma skyabs gsum kun 'dus la// gsol ba= /ma hā yo ga pad+ma gsung gi lha// dam ye gdod nas dbyer med lhun grub pa// spros pa'i yan lag kun spang blo mchog yul// ye rdzogs lha yi ting 'dzin mthar phyin shog /srid gsum 'byung po 'dar byed bzhad pa'i sgra// grags stong sngags kyi dbyangs su blangs pa'i mthus// log smon smin pa'i gdug can thul ba dang*// chos dbyings rol pa'i rta skad 'grub par shog /ma chags pad+ma'i rigs rnams kun gyi rje// 'khor 'das kun la pad+ma'i zlos gar gyis// dbang bsgyur pad+ma rgyal po rtsal grags pa// pad+ma gsung dbang rdo rje chos 'grub shog /ces pa 'di ni nye bar gnas pa'i sbyin pa'i ming can gyi ngor sngags gzugs pad+ma rā dza la maṃ tas bris pa'o// // ༈ /rta mgrin gsang sgrub bsgom par 'dod pa ni/ thog mar mchod rdzas rnams la rdo rje'i rtse'i nang mchod gtor te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las ye shes kyi kā pa la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo rnams dwangs shing thog pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ dharmā ra ṇi brjod rol chen byin dbab/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs nas/ brlab tu gsol tshar gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bha wa shud+dho3haṃ/

stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma klu brgyad bsnol ba'i steng du hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ljang gu/ g.yon zhal dkar po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal bsgrad pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing*/ ljags 'dril ba/ smin ma dang sma ra dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ dbu gsum gyi gtsug na rta mgo ljang gu gsum kha gdangs shing rta skad mtsher ba/ rngogs ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phro bas stong gsum gang ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi dang po sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pa na mdung thung*/ gsum pa na rgyu zhags 'dzin pa/ glang chen gyi ko rlon dang*/ zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhis stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ mi skra'i tshangs skud dang*/ khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bus brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas pa bzhi bskum zhing*/ g.yon pa bzhi brkyangs pas klu chen po brgyad sbrul gyi rnam par brdzis pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du bzhugs pa/ de'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rta mgrin tshon gang bas go mtshams med par gtams pa/ rang dang de thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong ltar sgrog cing me dpung 'bar bas gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad gzhob thul thul bsreg par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma ta krita badz+ra kro dha h+ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: ces brgya stong la sogs pa bzlas pa'o// bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra du na bh+yo trig nan hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya bh+yoḥ

sa ma ya bzlog sa ma ya gtubs/ sa ma ya byer/ sa ma ya rbad/ sa ma ya sbud/ sa ma ya rbad rbud phaṭa ya 'byung po ma ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pa'i drag sngags 'di yang nyer gcig tsam re bzlas pa'i mthar/ phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gtor ma rnams/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu gdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i nang du gdug pa can gyi sha khrag rus pa sna tshogs kyi steng du go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ bh+rūm̐ ām̐ dz+rīṃ kham̐ hūm̐ las ye shes lnga'i ngo bo rnams gsal ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams brtsegs pa las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu ba'i rlangs pa yig 'bru gsum la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang 'bru gsum las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams 'bru gsum dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par byon nas rdzas steng gi yig 'bru gsum la thim pas/ yig 'bru brjid dang ldan pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur nas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ

gsum mam/ mdun gyis nam mkha' paṃ las pad+ma sogs sku can du gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las bla ma'i ngo bo 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ hrīḥpad+man+ta krita sogs nas/ i daṃ ba liṃ bhūñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba sha trūṃ bighān ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ lan gsum sogs kyi gtor ma bsngos/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza pad+ma he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra/ sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rnams/ pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i mtha' can gyis mchod/ mtshan sngags la/ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ mahā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes btags pa'i sman raka gis mchod/ hrīḥ spyan ras gzigs sprul hrīḥlas khro bo'i sku// chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos// log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'dul mdzad pa// rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal bstod// de nas yig brgya lan gsum/ nongs pa bzod gsol rten yod na brten bzhugs/ med na gshegs gsol/ gnas gsum srung*/ dge ba bsngo/ bla ma yi dam chos srung gi bkra shis rnams bya'o// dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i sgrubs thabs 'di// chos sbyin mi zad dal 'gro rgyun bzhin spel// dge des 'gro kun bgegs tshogs kun zhi nas// grub gnyis 'bras bu myur du thob phyir bsngo// ces smon tshig nyung ngu 'di'ang rnam gser mkhan rgan kun rgyan nas spel ba dge legs 'phel/ me sbrul zla ba bcu pa'i tshes 4la// //dge'o//
// ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
